methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free AI workshops by a Norfolk native targeting community access represents grassroots capability-building outside traditional tech hubs, signaling potential for distributed AI fluency through peer-to-peer knowledge transfer rather than institutional or platform-mediated adoption.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches WorkAI Lab to prepare leaders for new era of technology - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College's WorkAI Lab indicates institutional infrastructure emerging in a non-metro region to develop deep AI capability for workforce preparation, potentially enabling distributed excellence if it creates sustainable peer networks beyond the initial cohort.

signals.title: TAYLOR: AI data centers increase Virginia’s urban-rural divide - The Cavalier Daily
signals.signal_reading: Student commentary explicitly naming AI data centers as drivers of urban-rural divide signals awareness that current infrastructure investments concentrate economic benefits in NoVA while distributing environmental costs, without mechanisms for capability transfer to underserved regions.

signals.title: ‘Shaping our future’: Company powering AI data centers invests $50+ million in Henrico, adding 200 jobs - WWBT
signals.signal_reading: A $50M+ AI data center infrastructure investment in Henrico with 200 jobs reinforces Richmond Metro as an emerging secondary hub, but the capital-intensive nature suggests concentrated expertise in operations rather than distributed AI development capability across the region.

signals.title: Norfolk businesses are being urged not to miss out on the benefits of artificial intelligence - Rayo
signals.signal_reading: Urging Norfolk businesses not to miss AI benefits suggests platform-based adoption opportunity where commercial entities use pre-built tools rather than developing deep technical capability, indicating potential for shallow but distributed economic participation in Hampton Roads.
